# casdoor_agent (Resource)

Manages a Casdoor agent.

Only the attributes set in the configuration are written to Casdoor. The other fields of the object, including the ones not listed here, keep their current values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "casdoor_agent" "assistant" {
  owner        = casdoor_organization.acme.name
  name         = "assistant"
  display_name = "Assistant"
  url          = "https://agent.acme.example.com"
  token        = var.agent_token
  application  = casdoor_application.portal.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the agent, unique within its owner.
- `owner` (String) The organization that the object belongs to.

### Optional

- `application` (String) The application of the agent.
- `display_name` (String) The display name.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The token used to call the agent.
- `url` (String) The URL of the agent.

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (String) The time when the agent was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of the agent in the `owner/name` format.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the organization and the name.
terraform import casdoor_agent.example <organization>/<name>
```
